# libpvr

libpvr is a multi-threaded software implementation of the PVR graphics chip from the Sega Dreamcast. The intention is to provide a drop in, portable render backend for Dreamcast emulators and homebrew projects.

Currently it's being used in the Nitrocast emulator and it's intended to replace the software backend in GLdc.

> Note: This library has been scaffolded and bug-fixed using LLMs to speed up development. I would not have had time to build this if I had to code it by hand. For this reason I'm releasing it into the public domain whence it came.
